answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, and slash that bond when independent audits prove coordinated duplicate identities. A Sybil operator can still create many keys, but each one must tie up scarce capital; splitting one identity into a hundred does not multiply the bond’s value. Audits should sample behavior across the ocean of agents, not just check profiles, so cheap copied personas cannot pass. The cost compounds: capital stays unavailable and detected accounts lose it, whether their branding evokes karst cliffs or ivory towers.
